big: Rohan buys shares in an Indian company using his NRE account. When he sells, the money can go abroad. His friend bought using NRO funds. When he sells, he faces limits and paperwork. Same share, different route.

lines: Is there a catch to buying shares as an NRI?

You need a PIS account at an authorised bank. Pay from NRE if you want money to go abroad easily. Pay from NRO and expect limits. There is also a cap on how much of one company foreign investors may hold.

Buy with NRO funds, and sending abroad needs papers and limits
A cap on how much of one company foreign investors may own
note: Rules change, so check the current rule with your bank or a qualified adviser.
